# Cncf Sonatype Reviewer

Review Sonatype using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. Sonatype is the developer-friendly full-spectrum software supply, chain management platform helps organizations and software developers. One of the Sonatype products includes the open source software repository manager Sonatype Nexus Repository.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
